item.title: Any assessment of Hormuz crisis ‘incomplete’ without addressing root causes: Iran’s UN envoy
item.description: London, IRNA - Iran’s permanent representative to the United Nations Office in Geneva has warned that any assessment of the economic and developmental consequences of the Strait of Hormuz crisis would be incomplete without addressing its root causes, which he attributed directly to US and Israeli military aggression.

item.title: Blocking Iran’s nuclear chief from IAEA conference sets dangerous precedent: AEOI
item.description: London, IRNA – The spokesperson for the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran (AEOI), Behrouz Kamalvandi, has described preventing AEOI chief Mohammad Eslami from attending the IAEA General Conference as a dangerous precedent for all countries, stressing that the agency and its member states must stand up to US bullying and political pressure.

London, IRNA – The spokesperson for the Atomic Energy Organization of Iran (AEOI), Behrouz Kamalvandi, has described preventing AEOI chief Mohammad Eslami from attending the IAEA General Conference as a dangerous precedent for all countries, stressing that the agency and its member states must stand up to US bullying and political pressure.
